reconcileDrift: Production planning currently calls PlannerEngine with today() and HarvestPlan persists no deterministic anchor. AC-051 requires suggestions/conflicts to restore or recompute deterministically after restart; advancing the calendar changes the first suggestion even when the stored plan is unchanged.
goal: Add a persisted, language-neutral plan anchor date and make all plan/continuous suggestion generation deterministic from stored plan state. Updating cadence/rotation/mode must preserve the anchor unless the user explicitly changes it; confirmed batches remain immutable.
acceptanceCriteria: HarvestPlan carries an explicit validated LocalDate anchor used for the first persisted/recomputed suggestion.
PlannerEngine derives cadence and continuous suggestions from the stored anchor rather than the caller's current date.
Restart on a later current date yields the same pending suggestion identities/dates/conflicts for unchanged plan state.
Cadence/rotation/mode updates preserve anchor by default and never mutate confirmed batches.
Continuous next-suggestion semantics advance deterministically from the later of the stored anchor and actual harvest input as specified by FLOW-005.
Scenario-named AC-051/052/057 tests cover restart/calendar rollover and update behavior.
No data codec/schema, component, UI, platform or ledger changes; specialist does not run Gradle and reports required persistence migration to root.
